report.answer: At live T+0 on 2026-08-19T18:11:03Z, 0/95 frozen package/version coordinates flipped (0.0%) under both OSV Scanner 2.3.8 and a direct OSV querybatch. The lodash@4.17.11 positive control went red and both probes named the same GHSA IDs (GHSA-29mw-wpgm-hmr9, GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm, GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh, GHSA-jf85-cpcp-j695, GHSA-p6mc-m468-83gw, GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc, GHSA-xxjr-mmjv-4gpg). metric_definition.coordinate_flip: A package/version coordinate with no T+0 OSV IDs has one or more IDs at its first later scheduled observation.
metric_definition.coordinate_flip_rate: coordinates first red at the horizon divided by 95 initially green coordinates
metric_definition.lockfile_flip: the first scheduled observation where either named probe reports any affected cohort coordinate
metric_definition.publication_to_flip_lag: first scheduled red observation timestamp minus OSV advisory published timestamp
metric_definition.censoring: The true flip is interval-censored between the previous green observation and the first red observation.
